name: Gate verdict
description: Review gate outcome pinned by spec-reviewer / pr-reviewer on their own review sub-task

name: Gate round
description: REWORK rounds spent on this review sub-task (POLISH does not count)

name: Arch repo
description: Repo short name the finding belongs to

name: Retrigger on done
description: Set by the squad leader on a sub-task it re-triggers for fix work (re-armed Build, or a Fix sub-task filed above a blocked gate). Value: the key of each blocked issue to flip in_progress and re-trigger once this one is done, comma-separated when there are several (DRK-1703,DRK-1704). Leader drops each key once that issue is re-armed and clears the property when none is left.

name: Wake count
description: Times the hourly run-recovery autopilot has woken this issue after a transient run failure. At 3 the autopilot stops waking it and hands it to the issue's human owner to review.
